excerpts.author: siladu
excerpts.content:
<@412614104222531604> when you get chance, please could you update withdrawal-devnet-4 with this experimental besu image: https://github.com/ethpandaops/withdrawals-testnet/pull/29

It _should_ get rid of our misreporting of bad blocks. 

For context, we're misreporting because during building a block we're reporting blocks that besu built and immediately invalidated (due to some concurrency bug), even though we eventually build a good one and return that to the CL. Makes no sense to be in the bad block queue.
